findings.claim: classify_dti's LOW-boundary comparison (demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py line 23) uses strict '<' instead of '<=' when comparing dti.basis_points to thresholds.dti_low_max.basis_points, so a dti value exactly equal to the low-max threshold fails the LOW check and falls through to the next (MEDIUM) branch instead of returning Band.LOW.

classify_ltv's LOW-boundary comparison (demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py line 31) has the identical regression pattern as classify_dti: it uses strict '<' instead of '<=' when comparing ltv.basis_points to thresholds.ltv_low_max.basis_points, so a ltv value exactly equal to the low-max threshold fails the LOW check and falls through to the MEDIUM branch instead of returning Band.LOW.

Within each of classify_dti and classify_ltv, the adjacent MEDIUM-boundary comparison (lines 25 and 33 respectively) is inclusive ('<=' against dti_medium_max/ltv_medium_max), establishing the file's own convention that a value exactly equal to a band's upper threshold belongs to that (lower) band. The LOW-boundary comparisons at lines 23 and 31 break this same-function convention by using strict '<' instead of '<=', confirming they are the regressed lines relative to the file's own established comparison style rather than an intentional asymmetry.

evidence.excerpt: if dti.basis_points < thresholds.dti_low_max.basis_points: return Band.LOW / if dti.basis_points <= thresholds.dti_medium_max.basis_points: return Band.MEDIUM ... if ltv.basis_points < thresholds.ltv_low_max.basis_points: return Band.LOW / if ltv.basis_points <= thresholds.ltv_medium_max.basis_points: return Band.MEDIUM

findings.claim: demo-repo/tests/unit/test_risk_bands.py already contains dedicated, pre-existing boundary tests pinning the intended LOW-boundary behavior for both functions: test_dti_at_low_max_boundary_is_low (lines 10-11) asserts classify_dti(default_thresholds.dti_low_max, default_thresholds) is Band.LOW, and test_ltv_at_low_max_boundary_is_low (lines 28-29) asserts classify_ltv(default_thresholds.ltv_low_max, default_thresholds) is Band.LOW -- an identical assertion shape for the untouched classify_ltv symptom.
